Brand identity case studyPune, India · Industrial chemical supply

Chemistry, in motion.

A brand system built around the logo Green Chemicals already owns: a growing leaf, a confident green, and a plain-spoken voice for industrial supply.

Story and concept

Supply that feels personal.

Green Chemicals is an independent industrial chemical supplier in Pune, supplying solvents, glycols, acids and specialty materials to manufacturers, cleaning and coatings businesses. The identity keeps the logo untouched and gives it a calm, organised system, so every quote, label and message looks equally dependable.

Purpose

Make sourcing industrial chemicals clear and dependable.

Personality

Straightforward, fresh, careful, human.

Audience

Procurement and production teams in manufacturing, cleaning, paints and coatings.

Values

Reliability, clarity, responsiveness, quality.

Creative concept: growth in the lab.

The leaf sprouting from the “g” already joins nature and chemistry. The system extends it: the leaf shape becomes a pattern, a corner device and a bullet, set against deep forest green and a clean laboratory white.

Logo

Clear space

Keep a margin on all sides at least equal to the height of the “g” bowl. This is a spacing guide, not a construction grid.

Minimum size

Horizontal logo: 100px wide on screen, 28mm in print. Below that, use the g symbol (16px, 5mm).

Colour

Leaf green, forest and ink.

Leaf green and ink were sampled from your logo files. Forest, sprout and paper are added supporting tones, forest echoing the deep green on your current website. CMYK values are approximate conversions; confirm with your printer.

Typography

Two voices, one rhythm.

Manrope handles headlines, interface and body copy. Instrument Serif Italic is a rare accent for a closing phrase, as on the current website. Both are free Google Fonts.

Guidelines

Use it consistently.

On white
Reversed on forest
Don’t stretch
Don’t recolour
Don’t put the green logo on green
Don’t use dark ink on dark
Don’t rotate
Don’t place on busy backgrounds
LogoUse supplied artwork only. Stacked for square spaces, horizontal for headers, g symbol for small icons.
ColourWhite or paper dominates. Forest anchors dark pages. Leaf green is the accent, about 10% of a layout.
TypeManrope for everything; one Instrument Serif Italic phrase per headline at most.
LayoutGenerous margins, left-aligned text, 12-column grid, 8px spacing unit.
AccessibilityInk on paper and white on forest pass AA contrast. Never set small text in leaf green on white.
ClaimsState only what you can show, such as your ISO 9001:2015 certificate. No invented metrics.
